name: thinkskool-root
description: Root package to orchestrate full stack deployment

scripts.install-all: npm run install-client && npm run install-server && npm run install-partner-school && npm run install-school-student
scripts.build: npm run install-client && cd Client && npm run build
scripts.build-partner-school: cd PartnerSchool && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-school-student: cd SchoolStudent && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix Client"
scripts.dev-partner-school: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix PartnerSchool"
scripts.dev-school-student: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix SchoolStudent"
